review_evidence: Reviewed the 32 primary timelib files. Although packaged as a date/time library, it formalizes the proleptic Gregorian calendar and duration/date arithmetic with a substantial proved algebraic interface.
The hydrated source contains 269 proposition declarations and 625 declaration-style items, including order/arithmetic characterizations for signed durations and calendar-operation laws.
The theorem-bearing calendar/time arithmetic specifications are useful formal prior art, so source-level retirement would be lossy.
summary: Reviewed timelib and retain its substantial proved Gregorian-calendar and duration arithmetic interface.
